$comment: IA for the rig.ai clone, derived from the running codebase: route table in src/App.jsx, page skeletons in src/pages/*.jsx, section components in src/components/*.jsx. Measurements behind each section live in CLONE_SPEC.md (Part 1 = homepage, Part 2 = secondary pages). All page copy is clone placeholder text (src/content.js, src/blog.js, src/legal.js).

meta.source: https://rig.ai/ (cloned locally as a React 18 + Vite + Tailwind v3 app)
meta.mirror: Local clone at the project root; original HTML/CSS/JS snapshot in reference/original-site/
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill, hand-authored ia.json from src/App.jsx + src/pages/*.jsx

categories.SHELL: Page chrome shared across routes: fixed visual overlays, header/nav variants, frame lines, section dividers, footer.
categories.HERO: Page-opening block that sets the page title or the primary homepage message.
categories.NARRATIVE: Homepage storytelling blocks that frame the problem and the product's answer to it.
categories.FEATURES: Homepage blocks explaining how the product works and what it can do, including stats and the terminal demo.
categories.CONVERSION: Waitlist sign-up surfaces and calls to action, including the waitlist dashboard.
categories.CONTENT: Substantive reading content: FAQ, blog listing, blog article body, legal prose.

shell.overlays.description: Three fixed, pointer-transparent full-viewport overlays stacked above everything: scanlines, grain noise, and RGB fringe.
shell.overlays.scope: Present on all 9 routes, rendered first on every page.

shell.header-hero.description: Header variant that sits inside the red homepage hero: black wordmark, ink-coloured links, dark chamfer CTA; collapses to a full-screen toggle menu at 768px and below.

shell.header-default.description: Static, transparent header variant for dark secondary pages: white wordmark, paper-coloured links, red chamfer CTA. The CTA list item can be dropped via showCta={false}, which shortens the header.
shell.header-default.scope: Every secondary page (8 routes); the waitlist route renders it without the CTA.

shell.content-lines.description: Fixed vertical frame lines that bound the homepage's main content column.

shell.section-divider.description: Full-width hairline divider between homepage sections. Rendered 13 times on the page: a top and bottom spacer divider, one between each pair of sections, and a doubled divider before How it works.

shell.footer.description: Site footer: brand column with wordmark and tagline, Connect and Legal link columns, bottom bar with copyright and a blinking 'all systems local' status dot, and a giant logo watermark.
shell.footer.scope: Present on all 9 routes, rendered last on every page.

hero.home.description: Full-viewport red homepage hero: faded logo watermark, two-line display headline, subline, two chamfer buttons (primary + outline), and a looping marquee ticker along the bottom edge. Hosts the hero header variant.

hero.page-title.description: Plain title block at the top of a legal document: h1 capped in width inside the 960px legal box, with a last-updated line.
hero.page-title.scope: The two legal routes (privacy and terms).

narrative.problem.description: Bordered box with badge and two-line headline, a full-width divider, then a grid of a surveillance-eye illustration (mouse-tracking pupil) beside four numbered problem cards.

narrative.intro.description: Product introduction: WebGL dither-shader band behind a centred badge, two-line headline and description, followed by an animated (SMIL) solution-flow diagram.

narrative.offline.description: Two-column 'work offline' block: an oversized drifting globe clipped by the section, overlaid with a three-card vertical flow joined by severed connectors, beside a badge, heading and short body.

narrative.three-col.description: Three equal columns separated by 1px dividers, each with a badge, heading and one-paragraph body (unlimited / privacy / latency).

features.how-it-works.description: Intro block (badge, title, body) above a two-column stepper: three auto-advancing expandable steps with progress fills on the left, a shader panel with an overlay card of ASCII bar charts that swaps and tweens height per step on the right.

features.capabilities.description: Badge and centred section title above a grid of six numbered capability cards ([ 01 ] to [ 06 ]), each with a heading and paragraph.

features.stats.description: Full-width strip of four stat boxes, each a mono label, a large value and a short note.

features.terminal.description: Grid-background block with badge and title above a monitor casing (vents, bezel, LED strip) framing a terminal window: ASCII logo, boot lines revealed on load, and a typing loop of prompts. Blueprint annotations sit left and right on desktop and become a two-column grid below the monitor on smaller screens.

conversion.early-access.description: Homepage waitlist band: dither-shader background behind a badge, headline and description, with the shared inline email form (input + chamfer submit, loading, error, and success-with-referral-link states) and a reserved verification-widget slot.

content.faq.description: Badge and title above a numbered list of eight accordion rows; each opens with a grid-row height transition and a rotating chevron.

conversion.cta.description: Closing homepage call to action outside the main column: vortex image, oversized line-art logo, bloom-glow logo, glitch heading, a large chamfer button that smooth-scrolls to the early-access band, and fine print.

content.blog-index.description: Single-column blog listing: h1 above hairline-separated rows, newest first, each row a date beside a title and excerpt; rows dim to 0.7 opacity on hover.

content.post-header.description: Article title block: h1 plus a meta row with byline and long-form date. For an unknown slug it renders a 'post not found' title with no meta row.

content.post-body.description: Article body in a 672px column: lead excerpt, then typed rich-text blocks (h2, h3, p, lists, blockquote, figure placeholder, hr; styles also exist for h4, code and pre), ending with a back-to-blog link.

conversion.post-cta.description: End-of-article waitlist box: sans-serif title, two short lines, and the shared inline email form. Omitted for an unknown slug.

conversion.waitlist-signup.description: Waitlist page form view: badge, headline, description, checkmarked feature list, and a self-contained email form. Shown when no saved sign-up exists.
conversion.waitlist-signup.scope: The waitlist route only, in its signed-out state.

conversion.waitlist-dashboard.description: Waitlist page dashboard view, shown instead of the form once a sign-up is saved: loading and error states, then position and referral-count stat cards, a giveaway card, a hardware survey (chip + RAM selects, save), referral link with copy, share-on-X and LinkedIn buttons, joined date, and a dev-only reset.
conversion.waitlist-dashboard.scope: The waitlist route only, in its signed-up state.

content.legal-prose.description: Legal document body in a 720px column: bold-paragraph section headings, mostly justified paragraphs, bullet lists, numbered lists nested up to three levels, and a block of centred bold lines.
content.legal-prose.scope: The two legal routes (privacy and terms).

templates.name: Blog post
templates.notes: Any other /blog/<slug> renders this template's not-found state (header without meta, no post CTA). Not counted as a route.

templates.name: Waitlist
templates.notes: conversion.waitlist-signup and conversion.waitlist-dashboard are mutually exclusive states of the same slot, chosen by saved localStorage state or a ?cid= param.
